key_impacts: Over 13 lakh people evacuated from Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.
21 deaths due to the cyclone; subsequent floods caused 23 deaths in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh.
Significant flooding occurred in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
Coastal Odisha faced fierce winds and storm surge; Gopalpur observed a 185 kph gust.
National highways and key roads were closed; helicopters moved people to safe shelters.
evidence_snippets: Odisha and Andhra Pradesh witnessed the greatest evacuation in Indian history with over 13 lakh people evacuated.
Due to the cyclone there were 21 deaths but the subsequent floods claimed 23 more lives in Odisha and 1 life in Andhra Pradesh.
There was significant flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
